description: This file defines an abstract class 'MergeIntoWriter' and several case classes related to merge operations in Spark SQL, including actions for matched, not matched, and not matched by source scenarios. It provides methods to specify merge actions like update, delete, and insert, with support for conditions and schema evolution.

classes.name: MergeIntoWriter
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods to define and execute merge actions with support for conditions and schema evolution.

classes.name: WhenMatched
classes.description: Case class for defining actions when rows match during a merge operation.

classes.name: WhenNotMatched
classes.description: Case class for defining actions when no matching rows are found during a merge operation.

classes.name: WhenNotMatchedBySource
classes.description: Case class for defining actions when there is no match by source during a merge operation.

methods.name: whenMatched
methods.description: Initializes a 'WhenMatched' action without any condition.

methods.name: whenMatched(condition: Column)
methods.description: Initializes a 'WhenMatched' action with a specified condition.

methods.name: whenNotMatched
methods.description: Initializes a 'WhenNotMatched' action without any condition.

methods.name: whenNotMatched(condition: Column)
methods.description: Initializes a 'WhenNotMatched' action with a specified condition.

methods.name: whenNotMatchedBySource
methods.description: Initializes a 'WhenNotMatchedBySource' action without any condition.

methods.name: whenNotMatchedBySource(condition: Column)
methods.description: Initializes a 'WhenNotMatchedBySource' action with a specified condition.

methods.name: withSchemaEvolution
methods.description: Enables automatic schema evolution for the merge operation.
